title: Fortune 10 scientist with free-energy and teleportation technology

tellings.quote: guy flies in super genius he can build uh over free energy plasma things he can do teleportation

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for UFO disclosure, says that in 2025 a scientist from one of America's ten largest companies flew in to Los Angeles to meet him, and that this man can build free-energy plasma devices and can do teleportation. Greer tells Michels he met him: "guy flies in super genius he can build uh over free energy plasma things he can do teleportation." If true, it would mean such technology already exists inside private industry.
